mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bookmark (user_no, place_no, created_at) VALUES (#{userNo}, #{placeNo}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bookmark WHERE user_no = #{userNo} AND place_no = #{placeNo}
mapper.select: SELECT b.bookmark_no, b.created_at, p.place_no, p.title, p.addr1, p.first_image, p.rating FROM bookmark b JOIN place p ON b.place_no = p.place_no WHERE b.user_no = #{userNo} ORDER BY b.created_at DESC
